fusions.name: Cinch the Straps
fusions.desc: Loops a cord through the harness of a target up to 5 tiles away and cinches it. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unlaced
fusions.desc: Cuts the cords that hold the target's plates together. It deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds and hauls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you, holding their attention for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Corded Lamellar
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of plates laced on cord: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
